notes: «- يعني ابن جعفر -» is an editor's gloss, left out; the name is the bare «محمد» (second occurrence).
«شك سلمة» in the saying is Salama's doubt inside the Prophet's words, not a new link.
«عن أبيه» names no one: a relation link (rule 7).
«بهذه القصة» refers to the story of Ammar, not a transmitter.
